items.title: WCAG Evaluation Methodology (WCAG-EM) 2.0 — Note Published
items.summary: WCAG Evaluation Methodology (WCAG-EM) 2.0 is published as a W3C Group Note. WCAG-EM describes a methodology with a step-by-step process to evaluate how well digital products conform to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2. WCAG-EM 1 was specifically for testing websites and web pages. WCAG-EM 2 also applies to apps and other digital products. For an introduction to WCAG-EM, see WCAG-EM Overview.
